results.description: In the Salinas Valley, the intertwined lives of the Trask and Hamilton families unfold against a backdrop of love, betrayal, and redemption. Set against the biblical tale of Cain and Abel, this sweeping novel explores the complexities of human nature, the struggle between good and evil, and the enduring power of family bonds. Through the eyes of Cal Trask, a troubled young man searching for his place in the world, Steinbeck masterfully probes the depths of the human heart, crafting a story that is both profoundly moving and unflinchingly honest.
